name: com.emindeniz99.quick-actions
description: Home-screen quick actions (the shortcuts revealed by long-pressing the app icon) for Unity, on iOS (UIApplicationShortcutItem) and Android (ShortcutManager). Create and remove shortcuts at runtime and get a callback with the action id on launch or resume. Zero native edits required. Unity 2021 LTS and newer (incl. Unity 6).

samples.description: On-screen IMGUI demo: add/remove shortcuts at runtime and watch the performed-action log.
